content: Attention layers were proposed for different NLP tasks. For example, NLI, with cross-attention between premise and hypothesis, Question & Answering and Machine Translation (MT). Specifically in the Machine Translation task, each word in the target sentence learns to attend the relevant words of the source sentence in order to generate the sentence translation.
